hook.title: Only 3% get 5/5
hook.say: Only three percent get all five right. Each one gets harder.

questions.q: How many legs does a spider have?
What is the capital of Australia?
Which planet has the most known moons?
questions.reveal_say: Saturn! It has over two hundred and seventy.

questions.q: Which letter appears in no U.S. state name?
questions.reveal_say: Q! Every other letter shows up.

questions.q: How many hearts does an octopus have?
questions.reveal_say: Three! And its blood is blue.

outro.title: How many did you get?
outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!
